description: This file implements the Positioning Information Exchange Procedure class, handling requests, responses, and failures related to positioning information exchange in a 3GPP context, including ASN.1 encoding and communication with CU-CP.

classes.name: positioning_information_exchange_procedure
classes.description: Handles the positioning information exchange process, including request handling, response creation, ASN.1 encoding, and communication with CU-CP.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine method that processes the positioning information request, performs sanity checks, and handles the outcome.

methods.name: handle_procedure_outcome
methods.description: Creates and sends the appropriate response (success or failure) based on the procedure outcome.

methods.name: send_ul_nrppa_pdu
methods.description: Encodes and transmits the PDU to CU-CP, with logging.

methods.name: create_positioning_information_failure
methods.description: Constructs an ASN.1 PDU indicating a failure in positioning information exchange.

methods.name: create_positioning_information_response
methods.description: Constructs an ASN.1 PDU with successful positioning information response, including ASN.1 encoding of SRS configuration and other parameters.
